title: 第2469章 我知道你为他而来第2468章 孟怀安
slug: 太古神族第2477章秘境之变
lines: 看著画面中浮现而出的中年男子，大殿內的三人虽然都是一喜，只是他们神色都异常紧张，因为刚才听说莫阳受孟怀安之託来寻寧若素的消息，他们心中便已经生出一种不祥的预感。
隨著画面变化，看著画面中的中年男子在那山巔隨风而散的那一刻，三位圣院强者都僵在原地。
虽然他们之前就有种不祥的预感，但看到画面中的场景，一时间也都难以接受，因为这种结果比他们想像中残酷了很多。
一位年少成名的盖世天骄，是整个天道圣院中公认最有可能登临帝境的绝世人物，最后竟然落得这般下场，甚至连尸首都没有留下。
那画面无声散去后，大殿中死一般的安静，三位天道圣院的强者都僵在原地，眼底儘是黯然之色。
莫阳轻嘆了一声，隨后开口说起了事情缘由，关於两位人族强者逝去，莫阳並无丝毫隱瞒，只是提到那位异族大帝陨落，莫阳说的是当时有一位神秘人族强者恰好路过，从而出手相助。
对於那两位人族前辈，莫阳心中同样满心的遗憾，他费劲手段，最后却只能眼睁睁看著他们消逝。
沉吟几息，莫阳开口道：“强敌已经陨落，孟前辈走得很洒脱，不过生前有一事相托，让我来天道圣院走一趟，找一个名为寧若素的人，帮他转达一句话！”
大殿中死寂了几息，隨后接连传出几声轻嘆，事已至此，他们也只能接受事实，曾和莫阳见过的那位中年男子轻嘆后，朝莫阳开口道：“我可以带你去，只是寧长老这些年一直在闭关，你此次前来，未必能见到她！”
莫阳闻言皱了皱眉，只是暗嘆一声，没有说什么，朝另外两位长老点了点头，隨即便跟隨那中年男子朝大殿外走去。
在天道圣院深处，这里是天道圣院的一处禁地，寻常时候连天道圣院的长老也不会轻易踏足此地。
“这里是孟长老曾经幽居闭关的地方，他一走数百年，我们总以为他天资卓绝，將来必有归来之日，谁想……寧长老一直在这里闭关，自从孟长老离去云游，她几乎就没有现身过。”那中年男子轻嘆看著前方那片禁地开口，语气中儘是遗憾。
“你自己进去吧，能不能见到寧长老，只能看运气了……”
莫阳点了点头，隨后朝前走去，这片禁地范围很大，视线中能看到十余座青山，河流在青山间蜿蜒，还有数个如碧玉般的湖泊，只是那青山上一眼看去儘是古木，看不到任何屋舍的影子。
莫阳没有散开神念去感应，只是按照那位中年男子所指的方向缓步前行，此地不知道多少年无人踏足了，曾经修建的石道台阶，早已被杂草彻底覆盖。
若不是这片区域处於天道圣院中，此地除了天地灵气浓郁外，与外界一片荒野之地没有任何区別。
按照那中年男子所说，绕过前方的几座青山，在禁地深处，那里有一座独特的山头，那便是曾经孟怀安最喜欢闭关枯坐之地。
莫阳默默走过，这片区域很是安静，除了风声，和水流传出的哗啦啦声响以及青山间偶尔传来的虫鸟鸣叫外，再无其他声响了。
他一路绕过前方的青山，来到了禁地深处的区域，在前方数里的地方，果然有一座相对独特的山头，山头不大，比其他的都低矮不少，能看到几间简陋的草庐在那山腰上，隱於一片绿荫中，若隱若现。
而隨著莫阳走近，抬头看去时，目光驀然一凝，因为在那蜿蜒上山的十道尽头，竟然默默立著一道身影，似是一直等在那里一样。
那是一位女子，从容貌看上去，还很年轻，脸上看不出太多岁月留下的痕跡，一眼给人的感觉很是朴素，但却一点不普通，整个人都透著一种素雅。
对方的身份已经不言而喻，身在此处，只可能是那位名为寧若素的女子了。
而且其修为也让莫阳心中暗暗惊讶，因为在他进入天道圣院，见过的所有圣院强者中，这女子竟然是修为最强的一个。
虽然还是不朽境，但却已经达到了不朽境巔峰，而且从那隱透出来的气息看，其距离准帝境仅有一线之隔了，若有契机，顷刻间便可迈入准帝境中。
而与那女子对视的瞬间，莫阳在那双眼眸中看到的是一种难以言说的悲意，这让莫阳都不禁止住了脚步。
虽然他是第一次来这里，也是第一次见到这女子，但从对方的反应来看，对方似乎知道他的来意，甚至知道他所带来的结果……
莫阳重重嘆息一声，沉吟片刻，还是继续往前，顺著那蜿蜒的石道继续往上走去，这石道和之前走过的地方不同，这里被打理得很乾净，半点杂草都没有，而且连石道两侧的草木都被精心打理过。
从这山头上的情况来看，她只是幽居在此，並非如圣院强者所说的那般她一直在闭关。
走到石道尽头，莫阳先是朝那女子行了一个晚辈之礼，开口道：“晚辈名为莫阳……”
还未等莫阳说完，一道极度压制著悲意，略显沙哑的声音传入莫阳耳中：“我你是为他而来的！”
莫阳一愣，说话间，那女子眼中滑落出两行清泪。
莫阳此时不知道说什么，默默將那支碧玉簪取了出来，隨后递给那女子：“这是孟前辈托我转交给前辈的。”
此时莫阳心绪也很沉重，他不知道如何开口，而是抬手一挥，曾经的画面浮现而出。
在那晨曦的微光笼罩下，一道伟岸挺拔的身影立在那山巔上，虽然生命走向终点，但依旧洒脱，只是难掩眼底的一丝眷恋，他亲手取出碧玉簪交给莫阳……
那女子看著那画面中浮现而出的身影，泪流满面，泣不成声，数百年別离，本以为终有相见之日，但却是以这种方式相见……
她那如绸缎般的黑髮，在此刻竟然以肉眼可见的速度变得一片雪白。
她天赋非凡，修为高深，岁月没有在她身上留下太多痕跡，但却抵不过情之一字。
莫阳历经过无数次死境逢生，亲眼看过太多生死离別，但每当遇到这种事情，却都难以淡然相对。
content_en:
Seeing the middle-aged man who appeared on the screen, the three people in the hall were overjoyed, but they all looked extremely nervous, because they had just heard the news that Mo Yang was entrusted by Meng Huaian to find Ning Ruosu, and they had already had an ominous premonition in their hearts.
As the picture changed, the three powerful men of the Holy Academy froze in place at the moment when they saw the middle-aged man in the picture scattering in the wind on the top of the mountain.
Although they had an ominous premonition before, when they saw the scene on the screen, it was difficult to accept it for a while, because the result was much crueler than they imagined.
An unparalleled talent who became famous at a young age, was recognized as the peerless figure in the entire Tiandao Holy Court who was most likely to ascend to the imperial realm. In the end, he ended up like this, and even his body was not left in the capital.
After the scene disappeared silently, the hall became deathly quiet, and the three powerful men from the Tiandao Holy Academy froze on the spot, their eyes full of gloom.
Mo Yang sighed softly, and then started to talk about the cause of the matter. Regarding the death of the two powerful human beings, Mo Yang did not hide anything. He only mentioned the death of the alien emperor. Mo Yang said that a mysterious powerful human race happened to be passing by at that time and came to help.
For those two human seniors, Mo Yang was also full of regret. He tried all means, but in the end he could only watch them disappear.
After pondering for a few breaths, Mo Yang said: "The powerful enemy has fallen. Senior Meng left in a free and easy manner. However, I have something to entrust you with during my lifetime. I am asked to come to the Tiandao Holy Courtyard and find a person named Ning Ruosu to convey a message to him!"
There was a dead silence in the hall, and then several sighs were heard one after another. At this point, they could only accept the fact. After the middle-aged man who had met Mo Yang sighed softly, he said to Mo Yang: "I can take you there, but Elder Ning has been in seclusion these years. You may not be able to see her when you come this time!"
Mo Yang frowned when he heard this, but sighed secretly without saying anything. He nodded to the other two elders, and then followed the middle-aged man outside the hall.
Deep in the Tiandao Holy Courtyard, this is a forbidden area of ​​the Tiandao Holy Courtyard. Normally, even the elders of the Tiandao Holy Courtyard would not easily set foot here.
"This is the place where Elder Meng once lived in seclusion. After he left for hundreds of years, we always thought that he was extremely talented and would return in the future. Who would have thought... Elder Ning has been in retreat here. Since Elder Meng left to wander around, she has hardly appeared." The middle-aged man sighed and looked at the forbidden land in front of him and spoke, with regret in his tone.
"Go in by yourself. Whether you can see Elder Ning depends on your luck..."
Mo Yang nodded, and then walked forward. This forbidden land was very large, with more than a dozen green mountains visible. Rivers meandered among the green mountains, and there were several jasper-like lakes. However, the green hills were covered with ancient trees at a glance, and no houses could be seen.
Mo Yang did not let go of his mind to sense it, but walked slowly in the direction pointed by the middle-aged man. No one had set foot in this place for who knows how many years. The stone steps that had been built had long been completely covered by weeds.
If this area were not located in the Tiandao Holy Courtyard, apart from the rich spiritual energy of heaven and earth, this place would be no different from the wilderness outside.
According to what the middle-aged man said, bypassing the green hills ahead, there is a unique hilltop deep in the forbidden area. It was Meng Huaian's favorite place to sit in seclusion.
Mo Yang walked silently, and the area was very quiet. Except for the sound of wind, the rushing sound of water and the occasional chirping of insects and birds from the green mountains, there was no other sound.
He walked all the way around the green hills in front and arrived at the deep area of ​​the forbidden area. A few miles ahead, there was indeed a relatively unique hilltop. The hilltop was not big and much lower than the others. Several simple thatched cottages could be seen on the mountainside, hidden in the green shade, looming.
As Mo Yang approached and looked up, his eyes suddenly froze, because at the end of the ten roads winding up the mountain, a figure stood silently, as if he had been waiting there.
It was a woman who looked very young from the appearance. There were no traces left by many years on her face. At first glance, she felt very simple, but she was not ordinary at all. Her whole person exuded a kind of elegance.
The identity of the other party is self-evident. Here, it can only be the woman named Ning Ruosu.
Moreover, Mo Yang was secretly surprised by her cultivation level, because among all the strong men in the Holy Temple that he had met when he entered Tiandao Holy Court, this woman turned out to be the strongest one in cultivation.
Although he is still in the Immortal Realm, he has reached the peak of the Immortal Realm, and judging from the faint aura, it is only a thin line away from the Quasi-Emperor Realm. If there is an opportunity, he can enter the Quasi-Emperor Realm in an instant.
The moment he looked into the woman's eyes, what Mo Yang saw in those eyes was an unspeakable sadness, which made Mo Yang stop walking.
Although it was his first time here and the first time he saw this woman, judging from the other party's reaction, it seemed that the other party knew his purpose and even knew the results he would bring...
Mo Yang sighed heavily, pondered for a moment, and then continued forward, continuing up the winding stone path. This stone path was different from the places he had walked before. It was very clean, with no weeds at all, and even the vegetation on both sides of the stone path had been carefully taken care of.
Judging from the situation on this mountain, she is just living here in seclusion, not that she has been in seclusion as the strong man in the Holy Court said.
When he reached the end of the stone path, Mo Yang first saluted the woman as a junior and said, "My junior's name is Mo Yang..."
Before Mo Yang could finish speaking, a hoarse voice with extremely suppressed sadness came into Mo Yang's ears: "I, you are here for him!"
Mo Yang was stunned. As he spoke, two lines of tears fell from the woman's eyes.
Mo Yang didn't know what to say at this time, so he silently took out the jade hairpin, and then handed it to the woman: "Senior Meng asked me to give this to senior."
Mo Yang was also in a heavy mood at this time. He didn't know how to speak, but he raised his hand and the scene from the past emerged.
Under the dim light of the morning sun, a tall and tall figure stood on the top of the mountain. Although his life was coming to an end, he was still free and easy, but could not hide the trace of nostalgia in his eyes. He personally took out the jade hairpin and handed it to Mo Yang...
The woman looked at the figure that appeared in the picture, tears streaming down her face, and she couldn't stop crying. After hundreds of years of separation, she thought they would meet one day, but they met in this way...
Her satin-like black hair turned white at a speed visible to the naked eye at this moment.
She has extraordinary talent and profound cultivation. Time has not left many traces on her body, but it cannot resist the word love.
Mo Yangli has experienced death and resurrection countless times, and has seen too many life and death farewells with his own eyes, but whenever he encounters this kind of thing, it is difficult to remain calm.
title_en: Chapter 2469 I know you are here for him Chapter 2468 Meng Huaian
